theme: Fast nearest neighbours without checking everything
title: Don't Just Connect the Closest: An Entry Set and a Degree-Budgeted Graph for Greedy Search
strategies: index-order graph + first-R indices as entries (no geometry at all -- baseline)
pure kNN graph (each node -> its M nearest neighbours) + first-R indices as entries -- the obvious recipe, all edges and all entries local
diversified pruning: reserve some of each node's degree budget for far, non-dominated 'bridge' edges, and choose entries by global farthest-point sampling for cluster coverage
alternative untested family: random-restart local search over entry sets with a fixed kNN graph
